rationale: US interest rate hike amid Trump opposition signals global financial tightening that will affect EU borrowing costs and Polish economy; Iran attack damage photos confirm escalation risk to energy markets.

top_events.title: US interest rates raised for first time in three years
top_events.label: US Fed raises rates despite Trump opposition
top_events.summary: Federal Reserve hiked rates unanimously despite fierce presidential opposition calling for cuts. This tightens global financial conditions, raising borrowing costs for Poland and EU economies.

top_events.title: Photos show widespread damage at US sites from Iranian attacks
top_events.label: Iranian strikes cause widespread US base damage
top_events.summary: Images reveal wrecked aircraft and destroyed buildings at US sites from Iranian attacks. Confirms serious escalation in Middle East conflict affecting global energy security and oil prices.

top_events.title: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
top_events.label: EU chief backs Canada associate membership plan
top_events.summary: Canada seeks closer EU ties after US relations breakdown. Could strengthen transatlantic economic cooperation and benefit Polish trade, though details remain unclear.
